youtube_description:
Attorney and auto safety expert Todd Tracy describes how to know whether you can sue for injuries suffered when an air bag deployed.

Video Transcript:
We will have people call us and say my airbag – I got involved in a car accident in a parking lot and my airbag fired and my face now looks like it has got a rash. It’s stinging. It’s burning. It almost looks like I hit a cactus. Well, guess what. In three or four days, that rash is going to go away. I’m only interested in airbags when they deploy and they cause catastrophic injuries or you’re dead or more importantly, when an airbag should have fired and didn’t fire, that’s when people get seriously injured or killed
(end Video Transcript)

If you, a family member, or friend have suffered serious injuries or they were killed in an auto accident, there may be a case against the car maker. The victim’s or family members of the deceased person may be entitled to significantly more money in damages than just a negligence case about the cause of the accident. 

Remember, whether you were at fault or not in the cause of the accident, car companies are required by federal law to make vehicles that will protect the driver and passengers from serious injuries or death.

Be sure to watch our Todd Talks on here on Facebook or YouTube to see if we should examine your auto accident.

For a free consultation call us at 214-324-9000.
